author: Catverter
description: English localization for Catverter Core Time.

en.description: Funny time units used directly and by speed ratios.

tail-flick.name: Tail flick
tail-flick.description: The minimum observable interval of feline disapproval.
tail-flick.scientificNote: Measurement requires a calm room and one unacceptable human decision.

door-negotiation.name: Cat-year
door-negotiation.scientificNote: The subject must request exit, reject exit, then request exit again.

snack-request.name: Snack request
snack-request.description: The time between noticing a human and requesting food.
snack-request.scientificNote: Hungry specimens may compress local time.

developer-hour.name: Developer hour
developer-hour.description: The amount of productive work before reorganizing the project structure.
developer-hour.scientificNote: Includes one brief detour into naming things correctly.

meeting.name: Meeting
meeting.scientificNote: Measured from first agenda item to first mention of follow-up.

angry-cat-wink.name: Angry cat wink
angry-cat-wink.description: The shortest measurable expression of feline disappointment.
angry-cat-wink.scientificNote: Usually followed by complete social isolation.

happy-cat-wink.name: Happy cat wink
happy-cat-wink.description: A slow blink universally recognized as affection.

hunger-after-eating.name: Hunger after eating
hunger-after-eating.description: Average delay before pretending starvation again.

programmer-minute.name: Programmer minute
programmer-minute.description: The time required to fix one tiny issue.

microwave-second.name: Microwave second
microwave-second.description: A second experienced while staring through the microwave door.
microwave-second.scientificNote: Subjectively much longer than SI seconds.

loading-bar-minute.name: Loading bar minute
loading-bar-minute.description: Time perceived while staring at a loading indicator.
loading-bar-minute.scientificNote: Repeated clicking has no measurable benefit.

monday-morning.name: Monday morning
monday-morning.scientificNote: Time dilation confirmed by office workers worldwide.

snooze.name: Snooze
snooze.description: The optimistic promise of 'just five more minutes'.

cat-nap.name: Cat nap
cat-nap.description: A short feline nap lasting approximately four hours.

netflix-episode.name: Netflix episode
netflix-episode.description: The amount of time before saying 'just one more'.
netflix-episode.scientificNote: Usually underestimated by a factor of six.

one-more-turn.name: One more turn
one-more-turn.description: Temporal anomaly observed in strategy games.

tomorrow.name: Tomorrow
tomorrow.description: The preferred completion date of every procrastinator.

be-there-in-five.name: Be There in Five
be-there-in-five.description: The universally accepted estimate for an imminent arrival.

lost-sock-search.name: Lost Sock Search
lost-sock-search.description: Average duration spent looking for the missing sock.
lost-sock-search.scientificNote: The washing machine denies all allegations.

quick-meeting.name: Quick Meeting
quick-meeting.description: A meeting confidently announced to last only fifteen minutes.
quick-meeting.scientificNote: Observed duration averages nearly one hour.

one-last-reel.name: One Last Reel
one-last-reel.description: The amount of time represented by 'just one more'.
one-last-reel.scientificNote: Frequently followed by forty-three additional observations.

shower-thought.name: Shower Thought
shower-thought.description: Average interval before solving yesterday's problem.
shower-thought.scientificNote: Ideas evaporate immediately after leaving the shower.

pasta-al-dente.name: Pasta al Dente
pasta-al-dente.description: The ideal waiting time according to every Italian grandmother.
pasta-al-dente.scientificNote: Exceeding this value may result in disappointed facial expressions.

steam-sale-browse.name: Steam Sale Browse
steam-sale-browse.description: Time required to buy games that will never be played.
steam-sale-browse.scientificNote: Library size grows independently of available free time.

ikea-trip.name: IKEA Trip
ikea-trip.description: Expected duration of buying one small item.
ikea-trip.scientificNote: Additional furniture acquisition is statistically inevitable.

cat-comes-when-called.name: Cat Comes When Called
cat-comes-when-called.description: Theoretical unit describing the delay before a cat voluntarily responds.
cat-comes-when-called.scientificNote: No experimentally verified observation has ever been recorded.
